# AGENTS.md

## Analytics Reporting Repo

- Python 3.12+ with `uv` (`uv run python ...`, `uv run pytest`).
- Generated report figures must be SVG files written under `reports/output/` (never `build/charts/` or `.png`).
- Existing local skill `.agents/skills/chart-reporting/SKILL.md` defines the project's mandatory Okabe-Ito palette and SVG output rules.
